style_prompt: Original landscape 3:2 picture-book illustration, delicate graphite pencil lines, soft translucent watercolor, colored-pencil grain on warm ivory textured paper, muted natural colors, no 3D or gloss, no text/letters/numbers/logo/watermark.
scene_prompt: Meaning: craftsmanship so ingenious and refined it seems beyond ordinary human skill. Modern scene: an artisan carefully carving a beautiful flowing sculpture from a single piece of wood in a bright community workshop; the finished carving has delicate leaves and waves, with precise tool marks and curled shavings, while a child watches in awe. Emphasize skillful human workmanship, not supernatural beings or magic. One artisan and one child; natural hands holding a small safe carving tool, correct contact between tool and wood, stable workbench and clamped wood, no dangerous action.
alt: 木雕師傅在工作桌前細心雕刻，孩子欣賞完成的精巧作品。
